votes.motion: Approve the meeting minutes of February 14, 2023.
votes.description: The Board approved the official minutes from its February 14, 2023 meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 07 of 2023 Bicycle Collective Loan.
votes.description: The Board authorized modifications to the approved loan terms and a limited waiver of the Loan Policy for a loan to the Bicycle Collective, facilitating New Market Tax Credits to fund construction of the nonprofit's headquarters at approximately 901 South Gale Street.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 08 of 2023, Affordable Housing Funding Priorities for FY 2023-24.
votes.description: The Board adopted the Affordable Housing Funding Priorities for Fiscal Year 2023-24, which guide the upcoming fiscal year's housing activities including requirements of the competitive affordable housing Notice of Funding Availability (NOFA).

The Board set public hearing dates for the RDA's Fiscal Year 2023-24 budget (May 16 and June 6, 2023) and set May 9, 2023 as the date to consider adopting RDA Budget Amendment No. 3 for Fiscal Year 2022-23.
